title: VTG 1983 Sir Freddie the Freeloader Red Skelton Porcelain Plate #5803/15000
descriptionText:
Red Skelton "Sir Freddie" collector plate, #5803 of 15,000, part of the "Freddie's Adventures" series. Created from an original work of art by Red Skelton, produced by Armstrong's (Crown Parian), 1983. Porcelain, approx. 8.5" diameter.
Condition: excellent — no chips, cracks, or crazing noted. Not intended for food use (decorative display plate). Ships well-packed.
